details:
Mozilla Firefox is an open-source web browser, designed for standards compliance, performance, and portability.

  * firefox: thunderbird: Sandbox escape due to invalid pointer in the Graphics component (CVE-2026-92032)
  * firefox: thunderbird: Privilege escalation due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component (CVE-2026-92010)
  * firefox: thunderbird: Privilege escalation due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component (CVE-2026-92006)
  * firefox: thunderbird: Privilege escalation due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component (CVE-2026-92011)
